summary: This video announces the five winners of the Halloween giveaway for 3 Heliolite Dice and 300 Wyrmarrow reward codes. Winners are instructed to reach out to Gorax on Discord within 24 hours to claim their rewards. The video also encourages viewers to join Discord and subscribe for future community giveaways.
